name: csp-wa-server
description: Baileys-based WhatsApp HTTP server for CSP platform (no Chromium — direct WebSocket protocol)
_why_baileys_6_7_18_exactly: EXACT pin, no caret/tilde — do not 'tidy' this into ^6.7.x.
wa_server.js is CommonJS (require). Baileys 6.7.18 is the LAST CommonJS
release: 6.7.20+ ship "type": "module" and 7.x is ESM-only, so any of those
makes the bridge die at startup with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM on Node 20 (the version
CSP machines get). It only 'works' on Node 22.12+/24, which can require() ESM
— that is why this bug hid during local testing and only broke on a CSP box.
To move to 6.7.20+/7.x, wa_server.js must first be converted to ESM (or use
dynamic import()). 7.0.0-rc13 was also a release CANDIDATE plus a native
whatsapp-rust-bridge — not something to ship to unattended rural machines.
